about: Background patterns for class event pages (labs/class-pages). Each event in a class config names one theme. svg = the decorative layer (viewBox 0 0 1200 800, drawn behind the page at low opacity); it uses var(--t1) var(--t2) var(--t3) for its colours, and these animation classes from the template: tw (twinkle), fall (drift down), rise (float up). accent = background behind white text (tags, numbered steps, buttons): keep it at 4.5:1 or more against white. text / textDark = the accent used for text on the light / dark page. Add a theme by copying one and changing the shapes and colours; the build checks contrast.
